readout: FANA synthesis rate, normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent (fold)
assay_method: Polymerase kinetic profiling (PKPro). 20 nM polymerase, 1 uM 30-mer DNA template, 100 uM each NTP, 1x ThermoPol buffer, 2x LC Green Plus; denature 95 degC 3 min, extend 55 degC 30 min, fluorescence every 6 s; rate from a linear fit of nucleotides per polymerase vs time; mean of three independent replicates.
remark: No WT row: the readout is already normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent, which is 1.0 by definition. The reference sequence is the engineered Tgo-D4K parent, not native Tgo. readout: Relative fitness F under 10 ug/mL ampicillin, the log10 enrichment of the variant in the selected versus unselected population minus the same ratio for wild type; higher is more resistant
assay_method: Bulk competition of a whole-gene NNS saturation mutagenesis library of TEM-1 in Escherichia coli. The gene was split into ten non-overlapping subgroups, each mutagenised by NNS PCR, and the products mixed in equimolar ratios and ligated as a single library. Cells were grown to saturation in non-selective media, then diluted and grown in the presence of the antibiotic to perform the selection; two replicate selections were performed and variant abundance read out by 75-bp paired-end Illumina sequencing. Per-variant scores were taken from the authors' MaveDB deposit.
remark: Positions are sequential over the 286-residue preprotein, as the deposit numbers them, and not the Ambler numbering the beta-lactamase literature uses: Ambler equals sequential + 2 up to sequential 236, + 3 for 237-249 and + 4 for 250-287, corroborated by the STFK and SDN motifs and by the ambler column of the same group's deposit urn:mavedb:00000070. 133 of the deposit's 4,997 rows carry no score and are dropped. The readout is the paper's relative fitness F, defined in its Equation 1 as log10(selected count / unselected count) for the variant minus the same ratio for the wild-type allele, so wild type is 0 by definition rather than by measurement; the deposit carries no wild-type row, and wt_readout records that defined zero, as it does for Jiang 2024-PRIME-TgoD4K.
